At that time, when Daksha saw Shiva riding the bull, his heart, which was stained with hatred towards Shiva,
became immediately pure, just as the water of a lake becomes clean from the rain of autumn. Note: Here is an example of why Shiva is considered auspicious. Whoever sees Shiva
with devotion and respect, their heart becomes pure. King Daksha's heart was tainted with hatred towards Shiva,
Therefore, when he saw Shiva with a little love and devotion, his heart
became immediately pure.
In the rainy season, reservoirs become muddy, but when it rains in the autumn,
then all the water immediately becomes pure and transparent. Similarly, Daksha's heart, although impure from insulting Shivaji, and because of which he had to be punished, but now Daksha had become conscious
, therefore, as soon as he saw Shiv with reverence, his heart immediately became pure. Bhavastavaya krutadhirnashaknodanuragatah.

In your lotus feet,
Keeping the mind steady, I do not deviate from those people who, by saying this, criticize me,
That my deeds are not pure. I do not care about their accusations, and I, in the same way,
out of compassion, forgive them, just as you show compassion towards all living beings. Meaning: Here, Shivji expresses remorse for being angry and destroying Daksha's Yagya (sacrificial ritual) work.

The wives of the sacrificers said: O Lord, that sacrifice was arranged according to Brahma's orders,
but unfortunately, being enraged by Daksha, Shiva destroyed the entire scene, and
due to their anger, the animals brought for the purpose of the sacrifice are lying lifeless. Therefore, all the preparations for the Yagya
have become useless. Now, by the gaze of your lotus-like eyes, may the purity of this Yagya place be restored again. Meaning: In the Yagya (sacrificial fire), animals were sacrificed to give new life to them; there,
the purpose of bringing the animals was this. In the Yagya, the sacrifice of animals and giving it new life
were proofs of mantra chanting power.
Unfortunately, when Shiva destroyed Daksha's Yagya, some animals
were also killed (one was killed to be sacrificed at Daksha's head). Their bodies were scattered
and the sacrificial site became a cremation ground. As a result, the real purpose of the Yagya was lost.
